title: Recreating multiplayer maps?
author: Foundatior
selftext:
I’m trying to remake Turok 64. Right now, I’m using maps that I recreated with Claude, which helped me read the original meshes and objects so I could recreate the environments in Unity. I’ve applied my own textures and lighting, but the maps still have the same layouts, spaces, and geometry as the originals.

How legally safe am I if I continue using these recreations?

Eventually, I’d like to create my own original maps, but for now, I’m using recreations of my favorite maps from the original game.

If I decide to publish my game, I assume I won’t be able to include these recreated maps, even if I use my own textures, lighting, and assets. Is that correct?

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: It's copyright infringement if you publish assets from Turok.

comments.author: enigmaticy
comments.body: Release it as a fan project
